Keepers.Name: Baker
Keepers.Head: BakerHead
Keepers.Notes: Flour-white toque and bib apron over a cream shirt with rolled sleeves; warm, round-shouldered stance.

Keepers.Name: Rancher
Keepers.Head: RancherHead
Keepers.Notes: Wide-brim tan hat, denim shirt, open leather vest and a red neckerchief; full beard.

Keepers.Name: Farmer
Keepers.Head: FarmerHead
Keepers.Notes: Straw hat with a green band, olive blouse with rolled sleeves and dungarees with a bib and straps.

Keepers.Name: Miner
Keepers.Head: MinerHead
Keepers.Notes: Leather helmet with a brass lamp, dark work jacket with leather shoulder pads, red kerchief and soot on the face.

Keepers.Name: Fisher
Keepers.Head: FisherHead
Keepers.Notes: Navy knit beanie, cream roll-neck sweater with cable bands and yellow oilskin bib overalls; gray beard.

Keepers.Name: Tailor
Keepers.Head: TailorHead
Keepers.Notes: Plum waistcoat over a white shirt, measuring tape around the neck, wrist pincushion and spectacles.

Keepers.Name: Trader
Keepers.Head: TraderHead
Keepers.Notes: Green eyeshade visor, white shirt with red sleeve garters, brown waistcoat with a brass watch chain, bow tie and a pencil behind the ear.

Keepers.Name: BalloonMerchant
Keepers.Head: BalloonMerchantHead
Keepers.Notes: Crimson lacquer coat, double-breasted with brass buttons and gold edging and epaulettes, cream silk scarf, brass balloon emblem pin, leather aviator cap with brass goggles pushed up, handlebar moustache.

Scope: Art only: static waist-up shopkeepers per storefront. No shop logic, dialogue, stock or animation.
